long_biography.plain_text:
His early business education came in his father's printing press, and a later £250,000 family loan supplied the decisive capital to scale Zenon Petroleum. He expanded from fuel trading into storage and distribution, then acquired control of African Petroleum and transformed it into Forte Oil. The venture established him as one of Nigeria's leading energy entrepreneurs.

Otedola sold Forte Oil to concentrate on Geregu Power, where he backed a major plant overhaul and brought the generator to the stock exchange. After selling his controlling interest in 2025, he redirected attention toward financial services. As First HoldCo's chairman and largest individual shareholder, he has made banking his principal current investment. His philanthropy spans education, healthcare and humanitarian relief, including work through family foundations.
